# bmc-main — unofficial fork

**Co-authored by Claude (Anthropic) and Jan Novák.**

A fork of [BraiinsForge/bmc-main](https://github.com/BraiinsForge/bmc-main), the software
of the Braiins Deck. It is not affiliated with Braiins. It adds GPU and runtime fixes and
new widgets: Victron Solar, Immich Photo and Deck Music.

- **[FORK.md](../FORK.md):** what differs from upstream (deviations first, then new
  features) and which branch holds each change.
- **[Upstream README](../README.md):** how to build and deploy, unchanged.

Every change sits on its own branch on top of upstream, rebased and pushed here every night.
